definitionZh: 在CSS中,在创建伪元素之前,该元素是选定元素的第一个孩子. 常用于在内容属性的元素中添加化妆品内容. 默认是内在的。
sourceDefinition: In CSS, ::before creates a pseudo-element that is the first child of the selected element. It is often used to add cosmetic content to an element with the content property. It is inline by default.
